maia (eng-security): Planning note: vendor pen-test next week. Need final confirmation on RBAC freeze, KMS access, and evidence retention by EOD.
derek (eng-sre): ACK. Freeze window?
maia (eng-security): freeze starts 8pm PT tonight through retest close. No role changes that affect prod access. Emergency changes need formal exception.
taylor (platform): For KMS: will provide ephemeral sessions via kms-proxy scoped to Decrypt for envelope key only, 4h TTL. We should log session creation + decrypt events to audit-export bucket.
maia (eng-security): good. retention 180 days for the vendor evidence slice. Also require KMS signing key for signed log slices during retest.
derek (eng-sre): adding minimal IAM snippet for the assessor role:
```
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/pt-envelope"}]}
```
ops-bot: Remediation tracker created SEC-PT-9001 at 1778901301
maia (eng-security): tracker should include: PR link, staging deploy ref, evidence log ids, and retest acceptance criteria. Please ensure each fix emits X-Pentest-Trace header to correlate.
taylor (platform): I'll add middleware in staging to surface that header to logs.
derek (eng-sre): scheduling dry-run Wed 09:30 PT to validate uploads and signed log slices. I'll post calendar invite.
maia (eng-security): final: no observability schema changes after freeze cutoff. DM me with exceptions. I'll post vendor handoff doc after dry-run. :white_check_mark:
